newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land unit acquires London hotel.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land unit acquires London hotel.

text.p: DBS Land said on Sunday that its subsidiary, Raffles Holdings Pte Ltd, has signed an agreement to buy Brown's Hotel in London for approximately Singapore $105 million.

The deal was signed on Friday between Richard Helfer, President and Chief Operating Officer of Raffles Holdings, and Graham Parrott, Group Commercial Director representing the Granada Group Plc, a DBS Land statement said.

"The acquisition of Brown's Hotel is undeniably a strategic move on our part as we find that not only does it fit very well into our first tier 'Raffles' brand of hotels but it is altogether an excellent entry point for us into the London market," Helfer said after signing the deal in London.

A newly incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary, Hotel & Resorts (U.K.) Ltd, with an authorised capital of 18 million stg was organised for the principal purpose of holding Raffles Holdings' investment in Brown's Hotel, the statement added.
Raffles Holdings owns Raffles Hotel in Singapore and runs Hotel Le Royal in Phnom Penh and the Grand Hotel d'Angkor near the Angkor temples in Siem Reap, Cambodia.
It plans to build hotels in Shanghai and Sydney and a 300-room hotel on the resort island of Bintan in Indonesia.
Raffles Holdings is the hotel arm of DBS Land and has an asset base of over S$7.5 billion.
